111    public function lastName($gender = null)
112    {
113        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
114            return static::lastNameMale();
115        }
116
117        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
118            return static::lastNameFemale();
119        }
120
121        return static::randomElement(static::$lastName);
122    }
